Strategy: Scaled awkward-band avoidance. Exact fits score highest; residuals between a third of the item and the full item lose a penalty equal to half the item size, while tighter and roomier residuals rank like Best Fit. The choice differs from Best Fit when the tightest fit falls in that awkward band while a looser bin can hold another item. It may help by scaling the deterrent with item size, but may fail if the penalty proves too small.

```python
def priority(item, bins):
    return [1000.0 if r - item == 0 else (-(r - item) - item / 2 if r - item > item / 3 and r - item <= item else -(r - item)) for r in bins]
```
generator_note: Scaled awkward-band avoidance: penalize residual in (item/3, item] by item/2, exact fit highest, else Best Fit.
